findings.title: The losing checkout still reads the holder’s event stream from the wrong checkout
findings.specimen: attavo/drive.py: read_invocation calls _events_path_for(root, stage, nn), which always resolves under the reader’s git directory, even when marker["events"] names the holder’s directory
findings.retires: The claim that every liveness input is read from the holder’s checkout, and that a healthy worker in another same-host checkout cannot be falsely recovered
findings.rejection_test: test_a_second_checkout_reads_the_holders_recent_events_before_calling_it_hung: create an old marker naming another checkout’s events directory, put a fresh heartbeat and a recent build-01.events.jsonl event there, then assert read_invocation(...).cls == "running" rather than "hung"
findings.severity: Blocking when the marker is older than stall_after_s while the other checkout’s worker has a fresh heartbeat and recent streamed events; harmless before the stall bound or for adapters that do not stream events
